BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents are thrilled to introduce 45 Fox Lodge to the Ratoath property market.

This impressive home features three bedrooms, three bathrooms, and a fantastic attic extension, offering ample living space. The ground floor welcomes you with a spacious hallway, leading to a comfortable living room at the front and an open plan kitchen/dining room to the rear. A convenient downstairs bathroom adds to the practicality of this floor.  Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms including a primary bedroom with en suite bathroom along with a family bathroom. The current owners have thoughtfully converted the attic space, providing even more flexibility.

The property is part of the mature Foxlodge estate and offers a convenient location in Ratoath village. All amenities are nearby schools, cafes, shops, bars and restaurants. Ratoath also provides easy access to the N3, N2, M50, Dublin Airport and Dublin City Centre.

Early viewing is advised.
